answer: Reaching eligibility takes 74 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The jade register is checked at draw time, juniper lists the eligible set, and wander seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 74 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 36 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
